title: Initialize project and configure build tooling
description: Set up Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS project. Configure tailwind.config.ts with custom theme (colors, fonts, spacing, border-radius from architecture-spec.md). Configure vite.config.ts (no source maps in prod). Add Google Fonts (Space Grotesk + Inter) to index.html. Add CSP meta tag and base HTML structure.

criteria.text: Vite dev server runs without errors
Tailwind CSS processes custom theme tokens from architecture-spec.md color palette
TypeScript compiles with strict mode
Space Grotesk and Inter fonts load correctly
CSP meta tag present in index.html head
index.html has semantic HTML5 structure

title: Implement conversion engine and unit definitions
description: Create types.ts with all TypeScript interfaces. Create units.ts with all unit categories, units, factors, and default pairs per architecture-spec.md. Create engine.ts with pure conversion functions (base-unit normalization for length/weight, formula-based for temperature). Create format.ts for number formatting with significant digits.

criteria.text: All 8 length units defined with correct factors
All 6 weight units defined with correct factors
All 3 temperature units defined with correct formulas
convert() function handles all unit pairs correctly
Temperature conversions are accurate for all 6 paths (C↔F, C↔K, F↔K)
formatResult() outputs up to 6 significant digits with trimmed trailing zeros
sanitizeNumericInput() rejects non-numeric input and returns null
Edge cases handled: 0, negative numbers, very large numbers, empty input

title: Build main layout and category tabs
description: Create the single-screen layout structure: app title, category tabs (Length/Weight/Temperature), FROM card, swap button, TO card, and quick reference line. Implement category tab switching logic in tabs.ts. Wire up app.ts as the central controller with ConversionState.

criteria.text: Single-screen layout matches wireframe from architecture-spec.md
Three category tabs render and are clickable
Active tab is visually distinguished with accent color
Switching tabs updates state.category and reloads default units
FROM and TO card sections are present with proper structure
Swap button is positioned between cards
Quick reference line renders at bottom

title: Implement unit pill selectors
description: Build the horizontal scrollable pill/chip unit selector component in selector.ts. Each unit in the active category renders as a tappable pill. Active pill gets accent fill. Clicking a pill updates the fromUnit or toUnit in state and triggers recalculation.

criteria.text: Unit pills render horizontally for the active category
Active unit pill has copper accent background with white text
Inactive pills have subtle border/background per design spec
Clicking a pill updates state and triggers conversion
FROM and TO selectors work independently
Pills scroll horizontally on mobile when they overflow
Default units are pre-selected per category (km↔mi, kg↔lb, °C↔°F)

title: Implement input fields and live conversion
description: Build editable input fields for FROM and TO values in input.ts. Wire up real-time conversion: as user types in either field, the other field updates live via engine.ts. Implement numeric input validation (digits, decimal, negative sign only). Format results via format.ts.

criteria.text: FROM input field accepts numeric input
TO field updates in real-time as user types in FROM
Bidirectional: typing in TO updates FROM
Non-numeric characters are rejected/stripped
Results display with proper precision (up to 6 significant digits)
Quick reference line updates with current unit pair (e.g., '1 km = 0.6214 mi')
Empty input shows empty result (not '0' or 'NaN')
All DOM rendering uses textContent, never innerHTML

title: Apply base styling with dark theme
description: Apply the Warm Obsidian + Copper color palette from architecture-spec.md. Style all elements: page background, cards with surface color and subtle borders, typography scale (Space Grotesk for numbers, Inter for UI), pill selectors, swap button, and quick reference. Implement CSS custom properties for theme tokens.

criteria.text: Page background uses --bg (#131110)
Cards use --bg-surface (#242019) with --border-subtle borders
Result value renders in Space Grotesk at 3.5rem/500 weight, input value at 2.5rem/400 weight
Labels render in Inter at specified sizes from typography scale
Copper accent (#C17F59) used for active states
Text hierarchy uses --text-primary, --text-secondary, --text-tertiary
Pill selectors styled with border-radius 6px (--radius-sm) — refined chip, not full pill
Swap button is circular with accent color
Responsive: centered card on desktop (max-width 480px), full-width on mobile
Overall look matches the premium 'digital Braun' aesthetic

title: Implement tab sliding pill animation
description: Add a sliding background pill that animates between category tabs when switching. The pill smoothly translates from the current tab position to the new tab. Content area cross-fades with slight vertical shift during category change.

criteria.text: Background pill slides smoothly between tabs (300ms, cubic-bezier)
Content cross-fades during category switch (opacity + translateY)
Animation respects prefers-reduced-motion
No layout shift or jank during transition

title: Implement swap button animation
description: Add 180° rotation animation to the swap button icon on click. Simultaneously cross-fade the FROM/TO values and swap unit selections. Use spring-like easing for overshoot feel.

criteria.text: Swap icon rotates 180° on each click (accumulates rotation)
Animation uses spring easing (cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1))
FROM and TO values cross-fade to new positions
Unit pill selections swap simultaneously
Conversion recalculates correctly after swap
Respects prefers-reduced-motion

title: Add input focus effects and pill press animations
description: Implement focus glow on active input card (copper-tinted box-shadow). Add subtle scale press effect on unit pill clicks (0.95→1.0). Add hover states for desktop on all interactive elements.

criteria.text: Active input card shows copper glow (box-shadow with accent color at low opacity)
Card border becomes more visible on focus
Unit pills have scale press effect on click (150ms spring)
Desktop hover states on pills, swap button, and tabs
Swap button has hover scale/glow effect
All transitions are smooth (200ms ease-in-out)
Respects prefers-reduced-motion

title: Implement number transition animations
description: Add subtle fade+scale micro-animation when result value changes. Digits should transition smoothly rather than snapping to new values. Implement in animations.ts.

criteria.text: Result value animates when it changes (fade or scale transition)
Animation is subtle and fast (200ms) — not distracting
Works correctly with rapid input (debounce or cancel previous animation)
No layout shift during animation
Respects prefers-reduced-motion

title: Implement light/dark mode toggle
description: Add a theme toggle button (sun/moon icon) in the header. Implement light mode color palette from architecture-spec.md. Default to user's system preference via prefers-color-scheme. Store preference in localStorage. Toggle transitions all colors smoothly.

criteria.text: Toggle button renders with appropriate sun/moon icon
Clicking toggle switches between dark and light themes
Light mode uses correct palette (warm off-white bg, white cards, deeper copper accent)
Default respects prefers-color-scheme system setting
Preference persisted in localStorage and restored on reload
Color transitions are smooth (200ms) during toggle
All text maintains WCAG AA contrast ratios in both themes

title: Accessibility audit and fixes
description: Ensure full keyboard navigation (Tab order through tabs, pills, inputs, swap, theme toggle). Add all ARIA attributes. Wrap result in aria-live region. Verify contrast ratios. Test with screen reader.

criteria.text: All interactive elements reachable via Tab key in logical order
Focus indicators visible on all focusable elements (copper focus ring)
All buttons and inputs have descriptive aria-label attributes
Result value wrapped in aria-live='polite' for screen reader announcements
Category tabs use proper ARIA role='tablist' / role='tab' pattern
All text passes WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1) in both themes
prefers-reduced-motion fully disables all animations
App is usable with keyboard only — no mouse required

title: Final visual polish
description: Fine-tune spacing, alignment, and visual details. Ensure responsive layout is pixel-perfect at all breakpoints. Add favicon.

criteria.text: Spacing consistent with 8px grid system
Layout centered and properly constrained at all breakpoints
Favicon present and displays correctly
No visual glitches at any viewport size (320px to 1920px)
Overall visual quality matches premium 'digital Braun' aesthetic goal
